# Abdulganiy Adeleke

> Developer relations engineer and technical writer focused on developer documentation, documentation testing, open-source contributions, and developer education.

This index points to Markdown representations of the site's published pages. The portfolio Markdown includes modal details immediately after the corresponding portfolio entries.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://abdulganiy.dev/index.md): Profile, selected site links, social links, and testimonials.
- [Portfolio](https://abdulganiy.dev/portfolio.md): Selected writing, tools, open-source work, and developer-community work. Modal content is inlined below each entity.
- [BOT Chain skills and MCP case study](https://abdulganiy.dev/portfolio/botchain-skills-and-mcp.md): Problem, approach, outcome, and project links.
- [Blog](https://abdulganiy.dev/blog.md): Published writing with dates, summaries, tags, and source links.
- [Resume](https://abdulganiy.dev/resume.md): Resume content in Markdown, plus the original PDF.
